additional_info.subject: ID0376778-DC/Si-D/IE[E7gWMK] - Failed to start charging CRM:00315001702
additional_info.body:
Hello Jason﻿,﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / S2 170003301
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
E7gWMK
Problem Description
: Failed to start charging after Preparing and RemoteStartTransaction: Accepted
Troubleshooting
:
As we already aligned, we checked the logs and came to the following possible conclusions:
User error:
As the customer reported, he tried to use DC1, unsuccessfully and then proceed to successfully use the DC2.
From the logs we see the following difference between DC1 and DC2
DC1:
DC2:
As you can see, there are no logs related to the PilotState or session start on the DC1.
This leads me to believe that the customer didn't use the DC1 correctly and possibly the locking mechanism didn't actuate which leads to the PilotState to remain in "A".
PilotState error/wrong reading:
Since the customer stated that the DC1 didn't work and DC2 did, here are my assumptions on where it might've failed:
Either the CP on the plug didn't send the correct voltage to the StateMonitor + EcoG
XD10 is not inserted correctly leading to 0V coming to both components
KF12 and/or KF14 input terminals are not getting the correct voltage or they are not transmitting/processing them correctly.
This last idea seems a bit out of place to me since we didn't find any other error and also from AWS we can see that there were 172 sessions on DC1 performed this last month
For future reference, your ticket number is
0376778
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
